summary.zh: 叙事工坊,AI 驱动的游戏叙事内容生成管线。它用 Tier + Mode 双层路由 + Planner 动态选步,自动适配不同品类的叙事深度,覆盖 117 个品类、9 个管线模板、20 席助手、29 种执行模式、6 种叙事原型,生成世界观→角色→剧情→对白的完整叙事。除从需求生成外,还支持 IP DNA 改编:上传已有小说/漫画/视频作品,标准化建树后提取叙事 DNA 并复用同一套管线改编成可玩叙事。改一处设定,它会沿依赖链标出哪些下游内容已经过期、需要重新生成,而不是让你自己去找。可视化故事树、单步重生成、逐段评审改稿、查看运行状态与导出结果,产出直接落进游戏项目目录。
summary.en: The Narrative Workshop — an AI-driven game-narrative generation pipeline. Using two-layer Tier + Mode routing plus a dynamic planner, it adapts narrative depth per genre across 117 genres, 9 pipeline templates, 20 assistant seats, 29 execution modes and 6 narrative archetypes, generating a full world -> characters -> plot -> dialogue narrative. Besides generating from a prompt, it also supports IP-DNA adaptation: upload an existing novel, comic or video, standardize it into a hierarchy, extract its narrative DNA and reuse the same pipeline to adapt it into playable narrative. Change one piece of the setting and it traces the dependency chain to tell you which downstream content went stale, instead of leaving you to hunt for it. Story-tree view, per-step regeneration, per-section review and editing, run-status tracking and export — results land straight in the game project directory.
